description: sendEvents sends its events as the request body: the reference's examples POST NDJSON (or one JSON document with format=json) with `-d`/`--data-binary` to /v0/events?name=<datasource> (https://www.tinybird.co/docs/api-reference/events-api), and its 400 row names a missing `name` as the common cause. The body is a preserialized string sent verbatim as application/x-ndjson. Live: POST /v0/events?name=distilled_events with two NDJSON lines answered 202 {successful_rows: 2, quarantined_rows: 0}; with wait=true, 200.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Newline-delimited JSON events (or one JSON document with `format: "json"`).
